name: Motivelink
summary: MOTIVELINK Co., Ltd., which rebranded from Yong-in Electronic Co., Ltd. in October 2024, is a South Korean firm specializing in the production and sale of electronic parts for the automotive sector. Its extensive product catalog includes a diverse range of transformers, such as main, core, fuel cell DC-DC converter, pulse, surface-mounted device (SMD), current, smart glass, and high-power variants up to 50KW. The company also supplies critical transformer elements like filters and inductors, alongside specialized MDPS (Motor Driven Power Steering) filters and clamp cores. Furthermore, Motivelink manufactures integrated charging control units, onboard chargers, switched-mode power supplies (SMPS), low-voltage DC-DC converters, chokes, and power inductors. These components are vital for numerous automotive applications, including audio and navigation systems, wipers, hybrid, plug-in hybrid electric (PHEV), and electric vehicle (EV) drivetrains, water and oil pumps, HID/LED lighting (headlights), electric power steering, power sliding doors, rear-view monitors, and defoggers. Established in 1977, the company is based in Yongin-si, South Korea.
